|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Sets slider line step and page step delta amount as well as optional step amount of [[CT_SLIDER]] or [[CT_XSLIDER]] with given idc of topmost user [[dialog]]. 
* Click to arrow - move by line
* Click to scale outside thumb - move by page.

{{Feature|informative|[[CT_XSLIDER]] does not use the ''page'' parameter, it acts as scrollbar when clicked on the bar. It also can only be horizontal.}}

|s1= [[sliderSetSpeed]] [idc, line, page, step]

|p1= idc: [[Number]] - control's idc

|p2= line: [[Number]] - value delta to move the slider when clicking on the outer arrows

|p3= page: [[Number]] - value delta to move the slider when clicking inside the slider bar

|p4= step: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) slider step

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= control [[sliderSetSpeed]] [line, page, step]

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= line: [[Number]] - value delta to move the slider when clicking on the outer arrows

|p23= page: [[Number]] - value delta to move the slider when clicking inside the slider bar

|p24= step: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) slider step

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>sliderSetSpeed [101, 0.5, 2];</sqf>

|seealso= [[sliderSpeed]]
